topic: Implementing full screen map view in dashboards
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on client requests for a full-screen button feature within the dashboards' map views. It was determined that this functionality is likely not native and would require installing a specific plugin.

The scope of implementation was narrowed down: the feature should initially be implemented only for the 'Traffic' map view, although it could potentially be added to the 'Inventory' section later.
decisions: The full-screen map button requires a plugin installation and is not standard functionality.
action_items: Implement the full-screen map feature specifically for the Traffic map view.
